svg.title: Automatic connection from AgentBuff
svg.desc: 1. AgentBuff signs an ES256 assertion for the owner and posts it to the service. 2. The service verifies it against AgentBuff's published keys, checks its age and stores its jti so it works once. 3. Access is checked without cache; an owner who never opened the web app gets an account created. 4. A 90 day MCP token is issued; only its hash is stored and the raw token goes back to AgentBuff once.
